basic_info.description: This expansive Spanish-Revival residence, designed by Charles Whittlesey in 1908, has been substantially and thoughtfully renovated into a warm, light-filled home with beautiful scale. Spanning approximately 5,900 square feet, this 5 bedroom, 5.5 bath Presidio Heights home offers a sophisticated floor plan, indoor-outdoor living and Golden Gate Bridge views. Large living room with fireplace and custom shelving. Spacious formal dining room with adjacent sitting area.  Remodeled kitchen and casual dining space. Large slide-away doors to the outdoor terrace. Upstairs master has an expansive walk-in closet, spa like-bathroom, sitting/yoga room and secluded deck with hot tub. Additional rooms include a view playroom, bedroom with built in desk, walk-in closet and en-suite bath and laundry room. Top level has panoramic view office, 2 spacious bedrooms, 2 full baths and a large south-facing view deck. Elevator and 2 car garage. Resort-like outdoor space.
